environment.description: Migration pod deployed in isolated EKS namespace 'db-migrations' behind internal NLB. The NLB target group has a source IP-based security group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b) that restricts inbound to 10.0.0.0/8 and 172.16.0.0/12 (VPC-internal only). Additionally, a Cilium NetworkPolicy with entity-based L3/L4 filtering is applied: spec.ingress allows only from endpoints matching label 'app.kubernetes.io/component: migration-controller' on TCP/5432. The namespace has a ResourceQuota and the pod runs under a PodSecurityPolicy (migrated to Pod Security Admission 'restricted' profile) with seccomp profile 'RuntimeDefault'. RBAC in this namespace binds only 'migration-sa' ServiceAccount to a Role with zero pods/exec permissions - the ClusterRole 'developer' has a namespace exclusion via OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sBlockExecOnNamespace' targeting 'db-migrations'. Process signals can only originate from PID 1 (tini init) or the kernel.

config.rbac_exec_blocked: OPA Gatekeeper K8sBlockExecOnNamespace constraint on db-migrations namespace
config.init_system: tini (PID 1, no signal forwarding from external)
config.service_account: migration-sa with minimal RBAC, no exec
